dedupe_keys.name: geothermal project on tu delft campus dapgeo 02 sonic and nmr logs

description: TU Delft and collaborating organisations publish geophysical measurements from research borehole DAPGEO-02 in the campus geothermal seismic-monitoring network. The release contains nuclear magnetic resonance, full-waveform sonic and suspension-logging measurements of P-wave and S-wave velocities. Measurements cover depths from 228 to 428 metres. The source distinguishes these measurements from the initial borehole inventory and links their processing documentation. Coverage: Coverage is the Delft geothermal monitoring site in the Netherlands. The custom time field gives 31 July 2022; instrument sampling intervals are not established. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: The description states a two-year publication delay. Current metadata reports no active embargo; measurement files were not retrieved. Simulation uses include geothermal subsurface and seismic-model calibration. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
